query: I just got back from hiking this morning, the trail up at Oak Ridge was so pretty this time of year, all the wild blueberries are ripe and I picked a whole container of them to make jam this weekend. On the way back I stopped at that new coffee shop on Main Street too, their lavender latte is way better than I expected, I got an extra one to bring home to my roommate. Anyway, I’m abroad right now and my mobile service isn’t working at all: airplane mode is turned on, my network preference settings are wrong, the WiFi calling feature isn’t working properly, my APN MMS settings are broken, my messaging and phone app permissions are both messed up, I think my SIM card might be unseated, and I have roaming turned off. Can you help me fix this?
